captions: Terminal 2, gate B12. Your best friend flies home tonight.
His mum is in intensive care. He hasn't slept in two days.
At the gate, he hugs you too long. “Pray for her, bro.”
“Of course,” you say. Like the five other times this week.
Boarding. He turns back once. His eyes say: please. Really.
Your rooftop. His plane blinks across the dark sky.
Hands raised. You say his mother's name. Then the five other names.
You text him: “I prayed for her. Just now. I'll keep going.”

post.caption:
“I'll pray for you” — 6 times this week. Prayed: 0. 🤲

We say it so easily. Someone, somewhere, is counting on it.

“Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” (40:60)

Tonight at Isha: six names. Say each one to Allah.
